Recommended quick wins given to customer during call (Ravi/Jordan):

- Region choice: prefer directing EU demo users to nearest Redwood region (e.g., eu-west) only for residency; otherwise route EU demos to us-east to compare baseline latency. Run A/B by region for 48h.
- Timeouts: set client-level request timeout to 20s and implement exponential backoff with jitter for 429/5xx. Avoid very short timeouts that cause retries and amplify load.
- Prompt guidance: trim system and remnant chat history before sending. Aim for <=600 tokens for interactive suggestions; move long context to embeddings/recall layer.
- Streaming: enable response streaming for UIs to reduce perceived latency (first token delivered <300-500ms for short replies).
- Model selection: test a lower-latency model variant for UI-critical paths (recommend: redwood-quick-1 / or less-quantized medium models). Compare latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Batching & concurrency: for small SMB traffic, keep concurrency low client-side (2-4), avoid client fan-out during demos to reduce bursts.
- Instrumentation: add per-request region header and log server-region + request_id; share a 48h sample with SE for deeper analysis (drive links above).
